text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I drop by the cafeteria for a breather,
when...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! How does it feel to win the
spring
Tenno Sho crown twice in a row?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it feels... delightful. I'm
pleased I could rise to the expectations
of the Mejiro family, my
team, and my
fans.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Okay, me! My turn to ask a question!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: I wanna ask something too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Um… Hey now…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's the haps? Oh, it's just you,
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Guess the spotlight's on you for holding
onto the
Tenno Sho crown. Give it up for
our Star
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh... And here comes someone who surely spells trouble...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Easy now, champ! I'm always on your
side, so let
me handle this!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, y'all! We're doing this in
turns—wait
first before asking a
question! Let's start with you
over there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you intend to keep the questions
coming
in...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Um, did you feel a lot of pressure to
keep the
Tenno Sho crown?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... There were times when
everyone's
expectations put me under
quite a bit of stress.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, I realized that those
expectations were
in truth a show of
trust.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This change of perspective transformed
what was
once pressure into a powerful
ally.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wow! So that pressure ended up helping
you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hear that? Now there's a quote for the ages! Give her a round of applause!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's right! McQueen has acquired the
secret
technique to turn the pressure of
expectations
into strength!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure why you need to reiterate
the point,
but I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The McQueen that lies before you
makes strength out of
expectations—ready to overcome any

hardships that may arise!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
In fact! With all of your expectations,
she could even polish off a plate of this
cafe's famous
Megaton Spicy Flamin'
Hot Curry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what in the world are you saying?!
That's
complete nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: This I gotta see!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Please, don't look at me so expectantly!
